full_judgment:
AFM Abdur Rahman J: This Admiralty suit, being proceeding in rent, was instituted by the plaintiff Bank Asia Limited on 17-2-2014 against the defendant No. 1 vessel MT Atlanta Ex. Vinashin Atlantic, IMO No. 9014834, flying Panamian flag and others, praying for a decree for realization of damage and compensation, at an amount of US$ 57,29,133.91 equivalent to Bangladesh Taka 44,48,67,247.80. 

 16. It appears that the plaintiff, being a financial institution, has filed the instant suit praying decree for realization of the outstanding dues of the invested money it has made in purchasing and importing the defendant No. 1 vessel. The plaintiff claims that the proprietor of the defendant No. 2 one Mr Md Gias Uddin was allowed to establish Letter of Credit through the plaintiff Bank for an amount of US$ 76,82,902.28, equivalent to Bangladesh Taka 59,92,70,000, conversion rate being US$ 1 = Bangladesh Taka 78, at a margin of 15%, upon which the defendant No. 2 deposited Bangla-desh Taka 89.89 million in two method, a part by way of cash deposit and part by way FDR deposit. Accordingly plaintiff established the LC by engaging its own fund of Bangladesh Taka 44,48,67,247.80 for the total LC value of US$ 76,82,902.28. 

 25. The learned senior Advocate Mr Kamal-ul Alam strenuously argued that the plaintiff is entitled to re-imbursement of the outstanding LC money along with interest at the stipulated rate of 18% which the plaintiff successfully proved by the sanction letters Exhibit 4 and 4(a). Moreover if the sale proceed of the defendant No. 1 vessel does not cover the claim of the plaintiff, then the plaintiff shall be further entitled to realize the balance decreetal amount from the sale of the other immovable property which are already mortgaged to the plaintiff by the owner of the defendant No. 2, Mr Md Gias Uddin. 

 27. It appears that the plaintiff invested Bangladesh Taka 44,48,67,247.80 in purchasing the defendant No 1 vessel MT Atlanta The disposal of the issue No. 3 entitled the plaintiff to realize the decreetal amount from the sell of the defendant No. 1 vessel. But if the sell proceed does not cover the decreetal amount, the plaintiff will be entitled to realize the balance decreetal amount from the other property of the defendant No. 2 or its owner Mr Md Gias Uddin. Moreover the sanction letters Exhibits No. 4 & 4(a) shows that the defendant No. 2 is liable to realize the interest upon the decreetal amount of 18% per annum till actual realization of the decreetal amount. Accordingly the instant issue No. 4 is disposed of in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants. 

 28. Since all the issues have been disposed of in favour of the plaintiff, the instant suit is required to be decreed in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendants. 

 31. The instant suit be and hereby decreed against the defendant severally and jointly for an amount of Bangladesh Taka 44,48,67.247.80 with interest @ 18% from the date of opening of the concerned LC till its actual realization. 

 32. The plaintiff is further entitled to realize the decretal amount by executing the decree by way of praying for sale of the defendant No. 1 vessel and to satisfy the decreetal amount from the sale proceed of the defendant No. 1 vessel. 

 33. Further if the sell proceed does not cover the decreetal amount, the plaintiff will be further entitled to realize the balance decreetal amount from the sell of the other properties of the defendant No. 2.
